title: World's Most Powerful Attack Helicopters
abstract: Discussion on powerful attack helicopters including Ka-52 Alligator (Russia), T129 Atak (Turkey), Chenghe Z-10 (China), and AH-64E Apache (USA).
rest_information: Discussion on the performance and design of different attack helicopters. Mentioned that AH-64E Apache is considered the best in quality and performance, while Ka-52 Alligator is noted for its appearance.
